timing.control_loop_scope: full intervening host command interval; each run first postwarmup loop may have a warmup endpoint
timing.real_time_factor_scope: nominal policy-time / aligned control-loop wall; excludes auxiliary reset simulation advancement

reference_comparison_scope: A-events and A-minimal are descriptive instrumentation/diagnostics modes; no causal attribution to CUDA-event overhead alone; reference B phases excluded

measurement_limits.device: same-stream elapsed including possible launch/host idle; not isolated pure kernel time
measurement_limits.observation_to_command: observed construction start to first software effort-target callback; not actuator execution
measurement_limits.h2d: empty host scope only; no policy H2D transfer exists
measurement_limits.d2h: diagnostic .cpu().tolist scope, not pure DMA or policy input transfer
measurement_limits.clock: actual host intervals include diagnostics, parity, reset and logging overhead; frequency is not inverse forward latency
measurement_limits.real_time_factor: nominal policy-time numerator; auxiliary reset physics excluded
measurement_limits.statistics: existing g4i2_analysis.statistics and summarize_timings; postwarmup successful event scopes only
measurement_limits.off: no probe clock/CUDA calls, but I2 diagnostics and outer host clocks remain
